turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not speak like this, O-lan. You will live. You will see our son married and settled. I will not lose you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not be content unless I have seen our son married and settled before I go.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I swear to you, O-lan, on my ancestors' honor, I will see our son married and settled before you leave us. I will not rest until it is done.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you would try, Wang Lung, but I have seen how our son looks at the maid. He wants her for his wife, and I want him to have her, to have a good life.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother-in-law, I... I don't know if I can be a good wife to him. I am but a simple maid, and I fear I am not worthy of his love.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry. I will take good care of her, and she will be a good wife to me. She is kind and gentle, and I am sure she will make me happy.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not trouble yourself with worries about my future. I will work hard and make a good life for myself and the maid, and you can rest easy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: What is this foolishness about not being worthy? You, a simple maid, would be a good wife to our son, and I will make sure of it. I will not have you worrying about such things.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother-in-law, I... I am but a simple woman, and I do not know if I can bear children, or if I can be a good wife to your son

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not worry, Mother, I am sure you will see me married and settled before you go. I promise to take good care of the maid and make you proud.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will try, Mother-in-law, but I am afraid I am not worthy of your son's love and respect. I am but a simple maid, and I do not know how to be a good wife.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see you married and settled, my son. It is my duty, my last duty to you.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I will take care of the maid and make you proud, I promise

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: It is not just about you, my son, but about the future of our family. I must see you settled before I go.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I am but a simple maid, I fear I am not worthy of your son's love and respect, and I do not know how to be a good wife to him.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you are afraid, child, but I have seen your heart, and I know you have good intentions. You will make a good wife to my son, and I will guide you until the end.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I am not worthy of such kindness, Mother. I fear I will not be able to take care of my husband as you have taken care of your family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please, do not think about the future when you are so ill. I will take care of everything and make you proud, just as you have always done for me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, please do not try to comfort me. I know my time is short, and I must see my son settled before I go.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not think of such things. You are tired and must rest. I will take care of everything, just as you have always done for me.

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
